$comment: Operator-curated list of marketplace modules baked into THIS cobblr-core image. Foundational + stock modules are NOT listed here — they live in modules/ and ship with the repo. Only marketplace modules are listed; the image-build pipeline (scripts/install-registry-modules.mjs) fetches each entry's tarball, verifies sha256 + ed25519 signature, extracts to /app/modules/<name>/. Edit + rebuild the image to ship a new module or version. See docs/design-decisions/marketplace.md.

modules.name: bricklink-connector
modules.$comment: Vendored mode = read from modules/<name>/ in this repo, skip the registry fetch. Used during the transition while bricklink-connector's external repo is being set up. Flip to source: "registry" once v0.1.0 has a signed tarball published in the registry.
